title: Diagram candidate
description: rounds/<round-directory>/<candidate-directory>/candidate.json. Candidate IDs must be globally unique in the session. The CLI checks asset containment, SVG validity, references, and earlier-round parent lineage.

toneId.description: A tone identifier. Project-specific tones are allowed; this is not restricted to the bundled catalog.

assets.description: Paths relative to this candidate directory. A missing dark asset is explicitly unavailable; the exporter never substitutes light artwork.
